kingsOfAngels.name: Amon
kingsOfAngels.description: Former holder of the Error Uniqueness and one of the most dangerous entities in history.

kingsOfAngels.name: Bethel Abraham
kingsOfAngels.description: Ancestor of the Abraham Family and one of the strongest spatial entities in history.

kingsOfAngels.name: Zaratul
kingsOfAngels.description: Leader of one branch of the Secret Order and one of the most important Fool Pathway figures.

kingsOfAngels.name: Antigonus
kingsOfAngels.description: Ancient owner of the Fool Pathway who attempted apotheosis.

kingsOfAngels.name: Medici
kingsOfAngels.description: Famous warlord, conqueror and one of the strongest Red Priest Pathway figures.

kingsOfAngels.name: Sasrir
kingsOfAngels.description: Principal subordinate and shadow of the Ancient Sun God.

kingsOfAngels.name: Ouroboros
kingsOfAngels.description: Ancient King of Angels possessing immense authority over fate.

kingsOfAngels.name: Kotar
kingsOfAngels.description: Ancient angel associated with nightmares, darkness and calamity.
